notes: min_vocabulary: the minimum of the open insertion lexicon (insertions outside it are allowed).
discourse_markers: allowed in CS texts and never counted as insertions.
tool_cue_words: an insertion containing one of these names a tool, so its tool_cue must be true (others may be true too, e.g. reschedule).
article_forms: all accepted; the lint normalises them to «ال order».
